decisions.rationale: Talonflame sets Tailwind to contest Trick Room; Gardevoir-Mega is primary spread offense; Incineroar cycles Intimidate and threatens Fake Out once Armor Tail falls; Kingambit is immune to Farigiraf's Psychic, hits it SE with Kowtow Cleave, and brings strong priority after Farigiraf is removed.

Lead Farigiraf+Camerupt pressures Trick Room while Armor Tail denies opposing Fake Out and Gale Wings priority disruption. Mega Mawile is the primary late-game answer to Mega Gardevoir and Dark types; Palafin supplies strong Water pressure and pivoting after Zero to Hero activation.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Talonflame Tailwind support and Will-O-Wisp pressure alongside fast Mega Gardevoir; Talonflame showed Sharp Beak Gale Wings with Taunt/Brave Bird. Kingambit can immediately KO Farigiraf with Black Glasses Kowtow Cleave. Hisuian Samurott uses Ceaseless Edge to establish Spikes and carries Chople Berry. Mega Gardevoir carries Mystical Fire, so retain Mega Mawile as a sturdier option rather than automatically Mega Evolving Camerupt.

decisions.rationale: Gale Wings Tailwind (+1 prio) goes first, doubling our Speed. Armor Tail blocks Fake Out on both foes. Incineroar Parting Shot on Farigiraf lowers its SpA/Atk before Trick Room resolves at -7 prio, then switches to Gardevoir — Gardevoir tanks Eruption far better than Kingambit (39–84% vs 81–176% OHKO risk). If Camerupt Erupts, it hits before the switch. We get Tailwind + their Trick Room, but Gardevoir can Mega Evolve next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Farigiraf + Camerupt again (same as game 1). Armor Tail confirmed: blocks Fake Out on both foes. Farigiraf carries Mental Herb. Camerupt likely Mega Evolves for Sheer Force Eruption. They brought 4; Mawile/Floette/Liepard/Palafin unknown which 2 are in. Game 1 they had Palafin and no Liepard/Floette. Expect Trick Room setup turn 1; Mental Herb blocks first Taunt. Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice remains our best offensive tool. Kingambit threatens Farigiraf but fears Camerupt's Fire moves. Conserve Incineroar for Intimidate cycling later.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room is nearly guaranteed (Mental Herb blocks Taunt). Under TR, Camerupt-Mega outspeeds Kingambit and can OHKO it with Eruption (73-196%) or Earth Power (78-205%) before Kingambit acts. Sucker Punch bypasses TR but does only 27-74% to Camerupt-Mega and fails on status moves. Gardevoir-Mega survives any single Camerupt-Mega hit (max 81% from Eruption, 67% from Heat Wave) and applies consistent Hyper Voice spread pressure. Kingambit is preserved for later positioning.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opponent leads Farigiraf+Camerupt again. Armor Tail confirmed. Farigiraf has Mental Herb. Turn 1: we Tailwind, Parting Shot Farigiraf (-2 Atk, -1 SpA). Switching Incineroar to Gardevoir. Opponent near-certain to set Trick Room this turn. Gardevoir-Mega takes Camerupt-Mega hits better than Kingambit. Plan: Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice chip under TR, Talonflame supports with Taunt/Brave Bird. Conserve Kingambit and Incineroar for midgame Intimidate cycling. Opponent back two unknown: Mawile/Floette/Liepard/Palafin; G1 had Palafin.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt)
decisions.rationale: Armor Tail denies Fake Out, while Mental Herb makes Talonflame’s likely Taunt unable to prevent Trick Room. Earth Power pressures Incineroar directly without committing the Mega slot before seeing the back line; keeping Mawile’s Mega available is valuable against the known Mega Gardevoir possibility.

Switch Gardevoir to Incineroar to preserve it and bring in Fake Out pressure. Talonflame's Gale Wings Brave Bird (+1 prio) chips Camerupt before it moves under TR. Incineroar resists Eruption (19.8-42.9%) and is immune to Psychic. Earth Power OHKO risk exists but opponent likely clicks spread Eruption. Next turn Fake Out Camerupt + Brave Bird can secure KO.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Switched Gardevoir (48%) out to Incineroar; Intimidate cycles. Camerupt-Mega is primary TR threat. Plan: Fake Out Camerupt next turn + Talonflame Brave Bird pressure. Gardevoir-Mega saved for post-TR or safe re-entry. Kingambit held as late-game cleaner. Opponent back two unknown from {Mawile,Floette,Palafin,Liepard}; G1 had Palafin.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand acts before Camerupt; Mega Camerupt then moves first under Trick Room among priority-0 attacks. Full-HP Helping Hand Eruption guarantees the KO on Gardevoir even if it Mega Evolves, while heavily damaging Talonflame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s revealed core includes Intimidate/Sitrus Incineroar, Sharp Beak Gale Wings Talonflame (Tailwind, Taunt, Will-O-Wisp, Brave Bird), and Gardevoirite Gardevoir. Kingambit is Black Glasses Defiant and threatens Farigiraf with Kowtow Cleave; Hisuian Samurott has Sharpness, Chople Berry, and Ceaseless Edge; Dragapult is Life Orb Clear Body. Preserve awareness that Talonflame supplies Tailwind and burn pressure. Mega Camerupt’s Helping Hand Eruption is a strong Trick Room line into Gardevoir/Talonflame.

decisions.rationale: Camerupt-Mega outspeeds both under TR and Eruption KOs 29% Talonflame before it acts. Incineroar survives (~30%) and Parting Shot lowers Camerupt's SpA, then pivots to Gardevoir. Talonflame's Brave Bird is a contingency if Camerupt uses Earth Power instead. After Talonflame faints, Kingambit enters free. Next turn: Gardevoir-Mega + Kingambit vs weakened Camerupt.

decisions.rationale: Must switch Incineroar; can't stay. Double-switch to Kingambit + Gardevoir-Mega. Under TR, Camerupt Eruption goes first: Kingambit takes 59-197% (SE), Gardevoir takes 29-93%. If Kingambit survives, Kowtow Cleave OHKOs or nearly OHKOs Farigiraf (53-176% SE). Gardevoir-Mega Hyper Voice chips both foes. Farigiraf is locked into Helping Hand, can't attack. Best chance to flip TR mode.

decisions.rationale: Send Gardevoir. Incineroar at 23% likely faints to Eruption before acting; Intimidate is useless vs special attackers. Gardevoir at 48% can survive unboosted Eruption (~50% chance) and Gardevoir-Mega Pixilate Hyper Voice + Kingambit Kowtow Cleave threatens Farigiraf KO, breaking TR core. Even if Gardevoir falls, Kingambit may survive to retaliate. Higher upside than sacrificing Incineroar for nothing.

Talonflame: Jolly Sharp Beak Gale Wings, Tailwind/Taunt/Will-O-Wisp/Brave Bird. Gardevoir: Timid Gardevoirite, initially Solid Rock, Hyper Voice/Psyshock/Mystical Fire/Protect. Mega Camerupt with Farigiraf Helping Hand is the primary Trick Room pressure line; Armor Tail blocks opposing priority targeting this side. Preserve Trick Room control and account for opposing Mega Gardevoir/Pixilate if it enters.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand Eruption OHKOs Kingambit and KOs 48% Gardevoir. Switching Kingambit to Incineroar gives Intimidate, and Incineroar resists Fire (takes 17.8-47.6% with Helping Hand, ~18% survival chance). Gardevoir Protects + Mega Evolves safely to get Pixilate. Even if Incineroar faints, Kingambit returns and we keep Gardevoir-Mega alive for next turn's Pixilate Hyper Voice. Attacking into Helping Hand Eruption loses both mons and the game.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Helping Hand Eruption acts before both foes under Trick Room, strongly pressures the 48% Gardevoir while retaining a high roll to remove Kingambit. Armor Tail denies Kingambit’s Sucker Punch into this side; this maximizes immediate two-KO upside while still heavily favoring Kingambit’s removal.

Armor Tail blocks priority aimed at this side. Mega Camerupt’s Helping Hand Eruption is primary TR pressure. HH Earth Power is a guaranteed OHKO on open-sheet Kingambit even after the known SpA drop; HH spread Eruption is not fully guaranteed into Kingambit. Preserve TR control when needed; Mega Gardevoir can use Protect to stall turns.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room expires after this turn. Farigiraf's Trick Room is -7 priority, so it moves last; if they reset TR, we attack Farigiraf first. Kowtow Cleave (85.5-160%) + Hyper Voice (32.2-60.5%) guarantees KO on Farigiraf before it can reset, removing Armor Tail and the setter. If they Helping Hand + Eruption instead, Kingambit likely faints but Hyper Voice still spreads chip; TR then expires and Gardevoir-Mega outspeeds everything next turn.

Farigiraf Trick Room is -7 priority so it goes last; we can KO it before reset if they try.

decisions.rationale: Helping Hand resolves before either foe’s regular-priority action, and Helping Hand Earth Power is a guaranteed OHKO on Kingambit despite Camerupt’s Special Attack drop. Removing Kingambit immediately is the most reliable conversion; Armor Tail also denies its Sucker Punch line.
decisions.notebook: Opponent core revealed: Impish Sitrus Intimidate Incineroar (Fake Out/Parting Shot/Will-O-Wisp/Flare Blitz), Jolly Sharp Beak Gale Wings Talonflame (Tailwind/Taunt/Will-O-Wisp/Brave Bird), Timid Gardevoirite Gardevoir (Hyper Voice/Psyshock/Mystical Fire/Protect), and Adamant Black Glasses Defiant Kingambit (Kowtow Cleave/Iron Head/Sucker Punch/Swords Dance). Armor Tail blocks priority targeting our side. Under Trick Room, Helping Hand + Mega Camerupt Earth Power is a guaranteed Kingambit OHKO even at -1 SpA; prioritize that over less reliable spread damage. Mega Camerupt + Farigiraf is the primary Trick Room pressure core; preserve TR control when opposing speed control returns.

decisions.rationale: Hyper Voice maximizes damage output hitting both foes. Though it can't OHKO Farigiraf (32-60% into 66%), it positions for a potential KO next turn if I survive. Any other move is worse: Psyshock on Camerupt leaves Farigiraf healthy to set TR; Mystical Fire is too weak; Protect just delays the inevitable. Need a high roll or crit to have a chance.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Re-establish Trick Room: Farigiraf survives any shown Gardevoir attack, and Camerupt also survives Hyper Voice. Earth Power can immediately finish Gardevoir from its revealed damage range; if it does not, Trick Room secures the next Helping Hand-assisted cleanup.

At -1 SpA, Helping Hand Mega Camerupt Earth Power cleanly pressures Kingambit and heavily damages Gardevoir; preserve Trick Room control when opposing speed control returns.

Gardevoir at 1% moves last under Trick Room; both Camerupt-Mega (Earth Power 35-50% min) and Farigiraf (Psychic 9-14% min) OHKO before Gardevoir acts. Hyper Voice is the only move with any chance — if both foes misplay (double Protect or Helping Hand+Protect), it can connect and potentially KO Farigiraf (32-60% into 33%). No alternative improves odds. Series is 1-0; losing game 2 is acceptable.

reflections.summary: We lost because our team was too reliant on priority moves and Tailwind, which were completely shut down by Farigiraf's Armor Tail and Trick Room. The opponent's Helping Hand + Mega Camerupt Eruption combo under Trick Room overwhelmed us, and we had no way to prevent or stall it effectively.
reflections.adjustment: For game 3, drop Talonflame for a Pokémon that can either prevent Trick Room (e.g., an Imprison user) or reliably KO Farigiraf before it moves. Lead with Incineroar + Gardevoir and double-target Farigiraf with Flare Blitz + Hyper Voice to deny Trick Room. If Trick Room goes up, use Parting Shot and Protect to stall turns while preserving your own HP.
reflections.notebook: Opponent runs Trick Room core: Farigiraf (Mental Herb, Sassy, Armor Tail) + Mega Camerupt (Sheer Force, Quiet, Eruption/Earth Power). Armor Tail blocks all priority, including Fake Out, Sucker Punch, and Gale Wings. Helping Hand + Eruption is their primary win condition. Farigiraf's Mental Herb makes Taunt unreliable. Back two unrevealed from {Mawile, Floette, Palafin, Liepard}; G1 had Palafin, so Mawile is a likely additional TR sweeper. Our Gardevoir-Mega is Pixilate Hyper Voice, Kingambit BlackGlasses, Incineroar Parting Shot cycle. Game 2 taught that Talonflame is dead weight into this matchup. For game 3, plan to prevent Trick Room by KOing Farigiraf early with Incineroar + Gardevoir lead; if TR goes up, stall with Parting Shot and Protect, and avoid sending Kingambit into Earth Power. Be ready for possible Mawile switch-in.

reflections.summary: Won because Farigiraf + Mega Camerupt was the correct preview plan: Armor Tail denied Talonflame’s priority Brave Bird, Trick Room reversed Tailwind, and Helping Hand-boosted Camerupt removed the opponent’s pivots and Kingambit while maintaining board control.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Camerupt plan next game; if Kingambit enters under Trick Room, immediately prioritize Helping Hand + Earth Power into it rather than relying on spread Eruption through its partners.
reflections.notebook: Opponent led Incineroar + Talonflame in game 2, using turn-1 Tailwind plus Parting Shot to bring in Gardevoir. Incineroar repeatedly pivots with Parting Shot and cycles Intimidate. Talonflame carries Tailwind, Taunt, Will-O-Wisp, and Brave Bird; Armor Tail is highly valuable into it. Gardevoir used Protect to stall Trick Room turns. Continue prioritizing Farigiraf + Mega Camerupt Trick Room pressure; target Kingambit with Earth Power once it enters.
